def factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30(df):
    """Slower normalized downside-impact asymmetry for predictive stability."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
    prev_close = safe_close.shift(1)
    safe_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
    ret = (safe_close / prev_close - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    dollar_volume = (prev_close * safe_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    impact = (ret.abs() / dollar_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    impact_base = impact.rolling(30, min_periods=15).median()
    impact_base = impact_base.where(np.isfinite(impact_base) & (impact_base > 0.0))
    relative_impact = (impact / impact_base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(upper=10.0)
    downside = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
    upside = ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
    asymmetry = downside.rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean() - upside.rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean()
    total_stress = (downside + upside).rolling(30, min_periods=15).mean()
    raw_signal = (asymmetry / total_stress.replace(0.0, np.nan)).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    factor = raw_signal.ewm(span=30, min_periods=15, adjust=False).mean()
    df_copy["factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_impact_weighted_asymmetry_slow_30"]
